segs.en: Lemon Tang was an absolute success! H2H has since released a Japanese version, and they are now preparing to perform in Japan to promote it (as well as their upcoming single!).

zh.ai: Lemon Tang 大获成功！此后，H2H 发布了日语版本，现在她们正准备在日本进行演出，以推广该版本（以及她们即将发行的单曲！）。

segs.en: H2H is running choreo drills with their backup dancers, forming a line of $$$n$$$ people in total. Not everyone coaches the same way, though: the H2H members can keep an eye on a big chunk of the formation, while some backup dancers can only focus on the people right next to them. Dancer $$$i$$$ has a coaching radius of $$$r_i$$$.

zh.ai: H2H 正在和他们的伴舞进行编舞训练，共有 $$$n$$$ 个人排成一列。不过，并不是所有人都以相同的方式进行指导：H2H 成员可以关注队伍中很大一部分人，而一些伴舞只能关注紧挨着自己的人。舞者 $$$i$$$ 的指导半径为 $$$r_i$$$。

segs.en: They can run at most $$$k$$$ training sessions. A training session consists of picking a single dancer to lead, who then works with themselves and everyone within their coaching radius. Formally, if dancer $$$i$$$ leads a session, every dancer $$$j$$$ such that $$$|i-j| \le r_i$$$ has their dance score $$$d_j$$$ increase by $$$+1$$$. The same dancer may lead any number of sessions.

zh.ai: 他们最多可以举办 $$$k$$$ 次训练课。一次训练课包括选出一名舞者担任领队，之后他会与自己以及其指导范围内的所有人一起训练。形式化地说，如果舞者 $$$i$$$ 领队一场训练课，那么每名满足 $$$|i-j| \le r_i$$$ 的舞者 $$$j$$$ 的舞蹈分数 $$$d_j$$$ 都会增加 $$$+1$$$。

segs.en: The performance will only be as strong as its weakest performer, i.e. the person with the smallest $$$d_j$$$. Can you help maximize this value?

zh.ai: 整体表现不会强于表现最差的那个人，也就是 $$$d_j$$$ 最小的人。你能帮忙最大化这个值吗？

segs.en: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n, k \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$): the number of dancers and the number of training sessions.

zh.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 $$$n$$$ 和 $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n, k \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)：舞者人数和训练课次数。

segs.en: The second line contains $$$n$$$ space-separated integers $$$d_1, d_2, \ldots, d_n$$$ ($$$1 \le d_i \le 10^9$$$), where $$$d_i$$$ is the dance score of the $$$i$$$th dancer.

zh.ai: 第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个空格分隔的整数 $$$d_1, d_2, \ldots, d_n$$$($$$1 \le d_i \le 10^9$$$)，其中 $$$d_i$$$ 表示第 $$$i$$$ 位舞者的舞蹈分数。

segs.en: The third line contains $$$n$$$ space-separated integers $$$r_1, r_2, \ldots, r_n$$$ ($$$0 \le r_i \le n$$$), where $$$r_i$$$ is the coaching radius of the $$$i$$$th dancer.

zh.ai: 第三行包含 $$$n$$$ 个空格分隔的整数 $$$r_1, r_2, \ldots, r_n$$$($$$0 \le r_i \le n$$$)，其中 $$$r_i$$$ 是第 $$$i$$$ 个舞者的指导半径。

segs.en: Output a single integer, denoting the maximum value of $$$\min_i d_i$$$ after assigning training sessions optimally.

zh.ai: 输出一个整数，表示对训练场次进行最优分配后 $$$\min_i d_i$$$ 的最大值。

segs.en: In the first sample, two sessions led by dancer $$$4$$$ achieve a minimum score of $$$3$$$: $$[3,1,4,1,5] \to [3,2,5,2,6] \to [3,3,6,3,7]$$
In the second sample, one session each led by dancers $$$1$$$ and $$$6$$$ achieves $$$3$$$. Reaching $$$4$$$ needs two sessions per endpoint, and no session covers both.

zh.ai: 在第二个样例中，由舞者 $$$1$$$ 和 $$$6$$$ 分别主持一场 session，即可达到 $$$3$$$。要达到 $$$4$$$，每个端点都需要两场 session，并且不存在一场 session 能同时覆盖两者。

segs.en: It may help to listen to the following song: https://open.spotify.com/track/7Duc0A2ye1eKwfCICOXYGT?si=f1e9ad0fd6e846cf

zh.ai: 听下面这首歌可能会有所帮助：https://open.spotify.com/track/7Duc0A2ye1eKwfCICOXYGT?si=f1e9ad0fd6e846cf

segs.en: Generating data for contests is very tedious work, and Viraj often gets bored doing it. During his breaks, he surfs various subreddits for pictures of the floofiest doggos. He also likes to ask his friends, including the other UTPC officers, for pictures of their pets to sneak into the test data he generates for geometry problems. However, Viraj's recent requests have been left on read, and he is infuriated at the lack of responses. He decides to kidnap ALL of their pets and store them at a remote location until enough photos can be amassed (some may even be posted on Reddit for karma). However, being a man of honor, Viraj decides to allow the officers a chance to get their beloved pooches back by solving his latest contest problem.

zh.ai: 为比赛生成数据是一项非常繁琐的工作，Viraj 经常对此感到厌烦。休息时，他会浏览各种 subreddit，寻找毛茸茸的狗狗照片。他还喜欢向朋友们（包括其他 UTPC 干事）索要宠物照片，以便偷偷将它们加入自己为几何题生成的测试数据中。然而，Viraj 最近发出的请求都被晾在了一边，迟迟没有收到回复，这让他对这种毫无回应的情况感到非常恼火。于是，他决定绑架他们的**所有宠物**，并将它们存放在一个偏僻的地方，直到收集到足够多的照片为止（其中一些照片甚至可能会被发到 Reddit 上赚取 karma）。不过，作为一个有原则的人，Viraj 决定给这些干事一个机会：只要解决他最新的比赛题目，就能取回他们心爱的狗狗。

segs.en: In each test case, there are $$$N$$$ lattice points on the Cartesian Plane such that no three points are collinear. The officers must consider every possible subset of the $$$N$$$ points, calculate the number of points in the convex hull of that subset, and add the sizes of the hulls together. This sum modulo $$$10^9+7$$$ can be decoded into a set of coordinates indicating the pets' location. The only issue is that all the officers hate geometry, so you need to help them out!

zh.ai: 在每个测试用例中，笛卡尔平面上有 $$$N$$$ 个格点，且任意三点不共线。警员需要考虑这 $$$N$$$ 个点的所有可能子集，计算每个子集的凸包中点的数量，并将所有凸包的大小相加。这个和对 $$$10^9+7$$$ 取模后，可以解码出一组表示宠物位置的坐标。唯一的问题是，所有警员都讨厌几何，因此需要你来帮助他们！

segs.en: The first line of input contains a single positive integer $$$N$$$ ($$$1 \leq N \leq 300$$$) representing the number of points. The next $$$N$$$ lines of input contain two space separated nonnegative integers $$$x$$$ and $$$y$$$ ($$$0 \leq x, y \leq 10^6$$$) representing the coordinates of each point.

zh.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个正整数 $$$N$$$($$$1 \leq N \leq 300$$$)，表示点的数量。接下来的 $$$N$$$ 行中，每行包含两个以空格分隔的非负整数 $$$x$$$ 和 $$$y$$$($$$0 \leq x, y \leq 10^6$$$)，表示每个点的坐标。

segs.en: Output a single integer representing the sum of convex hull sizes over all subsets of points modulo $$$10^9+7$$$.

zh.ai: 输出一个整数，表示所有点集子集的凸包大小之和对 $$$10^9+7$$$ 取模的结果。

segs.en: The size of the convex hull of a subset of less than 3 points is simply the size of the subset.

zh.ai: 少于 3 个点的子集的凸包大小就是该子集的大小。
